40:    * Create a primitive containing a boolean value.

43:    */

51:    *
52:    * @param number the value to create the primitive with.
53:    */
54:   @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") // superclass constructor
55:   public JsonPrimitive(Number number) {

60:    * Create a primitive containing a String value.
61:    *
62:    * @param string the value to create the primitive with.
63:    */

67:   }

69:   /**
70:    * Create a primitive containing a character. The character is turned into a one character String
71:    * since JSON only supports String.
72:    *
73:    * @param c the value to create the primitive with.
74:    */

76:   public JsonPrimitive(Character c) {
77:     // convert characters to strings since in JSON, characters are represented as a single
78:     // character string

80:   }

82:   /**
83:    * Returns the same value as primitives are immutable.
84:    *

86:    */

93:    * Check whether this primitive contains a boolean value.
94:    *
95:    * @return true if this primitive contains a boolean value, false otherwise.
96:    */

101:   /**
102:    * Convenience method to get this element as a boolean value.
103:    * If this primitive {@linkplain #isBoolean() is not a boolean}, the string value
104:    * is parsed using {@link Boolean#parseBoolean(String)}. This means {@code "true"} (ignoring
105:    * case) is considered {@code true} and any other value is considered {@code false}.
106:    */
107:   @Override
108:   public boolean getAsBoolean() {
109:     if (isBoolean()) {
110:       return (Boolean) value;
111:     }
112: 	// Check to see if the value as a String is "true" in any case.
113:     return Boolean.parseBoolean(getAsString());
114:   }

116:   /**
117:    * Check whether this primitive contains a Number.
118:    *
119:    * @return true if this primitive contains a Number, false otherwise.
120:    */
121:   public boolean isNumber() {
122:     return value instanceof Number;
123:   }

125:   /**
126:    * Convenience method to get this element as a {@link Number}.
127:    * If this primitive {@linkplain #isString() is a string}, a lazily parsed {@code Number}

153:   @Override
154:   public String getAsString() {
155:     if (value instanceof String) {
156:       return (String) value;
157:     } else if (isNumber()) {
158:       return getAsNumber().toString();
159:     } else if (isBoolean()) {

276:   public boolean equals(Object obj) {

279:     }

284:     if (value == null) {

294:       double b = other.getAsNumber().doubleValue();
295:       return a == b || (Double.isNaN(a) && Double.isNaN(b));

306:       Number number = (Number) primitive.value;
307:       return number instanceof BigInteger || number instanceof Long || number instanceof Integer

313:   /**

318:     if (out.getClass() != JsonWriter.class) {
319:       if (element == null || element.isJsonNull()) {
320:         out.nullValue();
321:       } else if (element.isJsonPrimitive()) {
322:         JsonPrimitive primitive = element.getAsJsonPrimitive();
323:         if (primitive.isNumber()) {
324:           out.value(primitive.getAsNumber());
325:         } else if (primitive.isBoolean()) {
326:           out.value(primitive.getAsBoolean());
327:         } else {
328:           out.value(primitive.getAsString());
329:         }
330:       } else if (element.isJsonArray()) {
331:         JsonArray array = (JsonArray) element;
332:         out.beginArray();
333:         for (int i = 0, size = array.elements.size(); i < size; i++) {
334:           writeJson(out, array.elements.get(i));
335:         }
336:         out.endArray();
337:       } else if (element.isJsonObject()) {
338:         JsonObject object = (JsonObject) element;
339:         out.beginObject();
340:         for (Map.Entry<String, JsonElement> entry : object.members.entrySet()) {
341:           out.name(entry.getKey());
342:           writeJson(out, entry.getValue());
343:         }
344:         out.endObject();
345:       } else {
346:         throw new IllegalArgumentException("Couldn't write " + element.getClass());
347:       }
348:       return;
349:     }
350: 
351:     if (out.stackSize == 0) {
352:       throw new IllegalStateException("JsonWriter is closed.");
353:     }
354: 
355:     if (element == null || element.isJsonNull()) {
356:       if (out.deferredName != null && !out.serializeNulls) {
357:         out.deferredName = null;
358:         return;
359:       }
360:       out.writeDeferredName();
361:       out.beforeValue();
362:       out.out.write("null");
363:       return;
364:     }
365: 
366:     if (element.isJsonPrimitive()) {
367:       JsonPrimitive primitive = (JsonPrimitive) element;
368:       Object encodedValue = primitive == this ? this.value : primitive.value;
369:       if (encodedValue instanceof Number) {

371:         String numberString;
372:         if (number instanceof LazilyParsedNumber) {
373:           numberString = ((LazilyParsedNumber) number).toString();
374:         } else {

376:         }

389:         }
390:         out.beforeValue();
391:         out.out.append(numberString);
392:         return;
393:       }
394:       if (encodedValue instanceof Boolean) {
395:         out.writeDeferredName();
396:         out.beforeValue();
397:         out.out.write(((Boolean) encodedValue) ? "true" : "false");
398:         return;
399:       }

401:       return;
402:     }
403:

406:       out.beginArray();
